source_observations.fact: rw5 receives uint64_t r[8] and uses dynamic r[src], r[src2], r[dst] accesses.
dp6_run_bytes declares uint64_t regs[8], passes it to rw5, then serializes all eight registers into the output.
Argon2 fill_block uses larger local block r,t structures and Blamka arithmetic.
automatic loop pipelining is disabled for tractability; target remains 4.000 ns.

hls_binding_evidence: Vitis binding report identifies dynamic RW5 r[] loads/stores as CoreInst=RAM, Width=64, Depth=8, Latency=1.
Physical routed reports identify regs_U/ram_reg_bram_* repeatedly in the worst paths.
